skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of grammar structure, semantics, origin, and development of linguistic phenomena.
Apply advanced grammar knowledge at level B2 and above according to the European Framework, equivalent to 6.0-6.5 IELTS.
Apply grammar skills effectively in listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
Analyze grammatical phenomena in specific life contexts.
Integrate knowledge about life, education, culture, society, and economy through explaining grammatical phenomena in specific text types.
Apply grammar knowledge effectively in professions such as editing, teaching English, translation, communication, and research.
Use academic English skills proficiently in explaining grammatical phenomena and in research.
Apply information search skills to understand topics in the curriculum.
Apply collaborative work skills and communication skills to discuss topics.
Develop self-study habits and accumulate knowledge with the right attitude towards learning.
Develop critical thinking skills in explaining grammatical phenomena in lecture content.
